# TaskForce

> TaskForce is an AI delivery operating system: you describe an outcome, scoped agents plan and draft every step, and a human approves each checkpoint before anything ships.

TaskForce sits on top of your existing board and repository. You state the goal; the system breaks it into steps, agents draft the work, and every step waits for a human sign off. Software engineering is the first proven workflow, and the same approve-at-each-checkpoint model extends to other delivery work. The underlying models can run on hosted providers or on your own hardware.

TaskForce is an evolving product: some capabilities are live today, others are in beta or planned. The public roadmap tracks what is shipped and what comes next.

## Product
- [Orchestration](https://taskforce-project.fr/product/orchestration): Turn an intent into validated checkpoints, from vision to deploy.
- [Local runner](https://taskforce-project.fr/product/orchestration#local-runner): Early access. Assign an issue to Claude Code and a runner on your own machine works in an isolated branch, then opens a pull request for a person to review.
- [Agents](https://taskforce-project.fr/product/agents): Scoped agents (CPO, CTO and COO roles) that work your delivery instead of one generalist.
- [Approvals](https://taskforce-project.fr/product/approvals): A human signs off at every checkpoint.
- [TaskForce Memory](https://taskforce-project.fr/product/brain-os): The memory layer that remembers every run and decision, powered by Brain OS.
- [Smart Assign](https://taskforce-project.fr/product/smart-assign): Route the right task to the right person or agent.
- [Collaboration](https://taskforce-project.fr/product/collaboration): Boards, issues and cycles in real time.
- [Analytics](https://taskforce-project.fr/product/analytics): Throughput, resolution time and workload.
- [Integrations](https://taskforce-project.fr/product/integrations): Connectors across many tools, sitting on the stack you already use.
